scientific_intent.family_rationale: Source README set operations serve IR/graph/database applications. Actual device mapping is dense SGEMM, not an assertion of irregular GPU traffic.
scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute all pairwise set intersection cardinalities, not Jaccard scores or end-to-end retrieval/graph quality.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: C_ab = |S_a intersection S_b| = sum_u 1[u in S_a]*1[u in S_b]. Source CPU packs binary incidence matrices and GPU SGEMM computes counts.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Finite integer universe; UInt32 file cardinality/universe/sizes/IDs, UInt64 totalElements. Source adds one to universe field: primary1000->1001, controls16->17 (IDs0..16).
scientific_intent.model_parameters: Actual original 1000-set/1000-universe/100-draw generator; per-set seed19937 reset yields 1000 identical95-member sets, asc/desc byteidentical. scientific_intent.independent_validation: Complete Python set intersections, not matrix multiplication; independently packed full expected binary inputs compared with every actual device readback. All Float32 integer counts<=1001 exactly representable.
